questions.stem: Explain the difference between a syntax error and a runtime exception.
markingGuide: Syntax errors occur at compile time due to incorrect code syntax.
Runtime exceptions occur during program execution and can be handled.
Syntax errors must be fixed before the code can run.
Runtime exceptions can be caught and managed using try-catch blocks.
questions.explanation: Syntax errors are detected by the compiler and prevent the program from running until fixed. Runtime exceptions occur while the program is running and can be managed through exception handling mechanisms.
